name: web_search
description: Search the public web. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets. Use this to discover sources; follow with web_fetch for full page content.

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch a URL and return page text. Use after web_search when the search snippets are not enough.

name: run_sql
description: Execute a read-only SQL query on the task's SQLite database. Allowed openers: SELECT / WITH / PRAGMA / EXPLAIN. Writes are rejected.

description.description: Optional one-line summary of the query's intent.

name: get_all_external_knowledge_names
description: List the names (titles) of every external knowledge entry for this database. Use this first to discover what domain knowledge exists before writing SQL.

name: get_knowledge_definition
description: Return the full definition of one external knowledge entry.

knowledge_name.description: Entry title or id (numeric 0 or database-qualified alien_0).

name: get_all_knowledge_definitions
description: Return all external knowledge definitions for this database. Prefer get_knowledge_definition for one or two entries; this may return a titles-only catalog when the full JSON is too large.

name: final_answer
description: Submit the final answer and end the conversation. Call this exactly once. Do not call any other tool in the same turn.

answer.description: Concise final answer to the user's question. For S2SQL, put the canonical query in a fenced sql block.
